name: std::sortable

declarations.code:
template <class I, class Comp = ranges::less, class Proj = std::identity>

concept sortable =

    std::permutable<I> &&

    std::indirect_strict_weak_order<Comp, std::projected<I, Proj>>;

intro: The sortable concept specifies the requirements for algorithms that permute a range into an ordered range according to Comp.

sections.title: Semantic requirements
sections.text: std::sortable<I, Comp, Proj> is modeled only if all concepts it subsumes are modeled.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: An int pointer iterates over {3, 7} and satisfies sortable.
